_url_note: Change to https://missionsfororphans.org/ when the site moves to its own domain.

widow_homes._note: Set both numbers (for example 9000 and 4200) to show a progress bar on widow-homes.html. Leave them null to hide it.

social._note: whatsapp: a number with country code (e.g. "2547XXXXXXXX") or a wa.me link; "placeholder" shows the icon and links to the contact page until the number is known. facebook and instagram: full links. null hides an icon.
